# Miraee

> Miraee is business travel and expense software, built by Tabhi, the company behind the Mondee travel marketplace. Employees ask the Miraee assistant for a trip and choose flights and hotels inside company policy. Finance sees every booking with its budget and GL code. Signing up and onboarding are free at any company size.

## Product
- [How it works](https://miraee.ai/how-it-works): booking inside policy, approvals only when something is out of policy, the finance view, and what happens when plans change
- [For finance](https://miraee.ai/finance): budgets, GL codes, finance dashboard, audit log, receipts matched to card charges
- [For travel managers](https://miraee.ai/travel-managers): travel policy on every booking, approvals, booking on behalf
- [When plans change](https://miraee.ai/when-plans-change): alerts and new options the traveler confirms
- [Pricing](https://miraee.ai/pricing): what is free (sign-up and onboarding, at any company size)
- [Spend review](https://miraee.ai/spend-review): an optional trip-by-trip review of last year's travel from one booking report
- [Security](https://miraee.ai/security): sign-in, data handling and the security pack

## Company
- [About Miraee](https://miraee.ai/company): built by Tabhi, the company behind the Mondee travel marketplace

## Compare
- [Compare corporate travel management software](https://miraee.ai/compare): how to compare tools for a company of 300 to 1,500 people on cost to start, policy controls, the finance view and changes
- [Miraee vs Navan](https://miraee.ai/compare/navan): cost to start, policy controls, the finance view and changes, with every Navan fact dated
- [Miraee vs SAP Concur](https://miraee.ai/compare/sap-concur): onboarding, travel policy, approvals and the finance view
- [Miraee vs Perk](https://miraee.ai/compare/perk): cost to start, the finance view of each trip and how changes are confirmed
- [Miraee with Ramp](https://miraee.ai/compare/ramp): keep the Ramp card and add travel booking with policy on every trip

## Resources
- [Resources](https://miraee.ai/resources): guides, a policy template and checklists for finance and travel leads
- [Business travel policy](https://miraee.ai/resources/business-travel-policy): how to write a policy people follow, with booking rules, approvals and limits
- [Business travel policy template](https://miraee.ai/resources/business-travel-policy-template): a template with a one-page rollout checklist, in Word and PDF
- [Travel and expense policy](https://miraee.ai/resources/travel-and-expense-policy): what to include, with example wording for limits, receipts and GL codes
- [Travel policy compliance](https://miraee.ai/resources/travel-policy-compliance): keeping bookings inside policy by making the right option the easy one
- [Travel expense reports](https://miraee.ai/resources/travel-expense-report): closing month-end on travel, with a close checklist
- [Corporate travel manager guide](https://miraee.ai/resources/corporate-travel-manager): running company travel on top of your day job
